display.purpose: Poster and section titles. Steel gradient only on studio black; solid studio black on the white sheet. The hero line uses the same face at 10.2vw–12.6vw.

headline.purpose: Two-digit indexes beside a service or a stacked project.

title.purpose: Uppercase service and project names under the index.

body.purpose: Quiet reading copy. About steps to weight 500; supporting lines drop to weight 300.

label.purpose: Uppercase ghost actions at 0.1em tracking. The contact pill uses the same tracking from 0.75rem.

shadows.name: contact-pill
shadows.purpose: The only shadow. It belongs to the contact pill and the sent-state disc, not to cards or sheets.

motion.name: ease-poster
motion.purpose: Poster entrances. Default duration 0.7s; about stills 0.9s. Once, from a 30px rise, skipped when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: duration-pill
motion.purpose: Contact pill opacity and ghost color washes.

motion.name: duration-sheet
motion.purpose: Contact sheet entrance, 28px rise. Skipped when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: marquee-scroll
motion.purpose: Two screenshot rows drift in opposite directions. They stay still when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: stack-scale
motion.purpose: Sticky project cards shrink as they pin. Off when reduced motion is set.

motion.name: scroll-smooth
motion.purpose: Document scroll-behavior. Poster sections do not add scroll-padding. Contact alone uses an 8px scroll margin.

components.name: Contact Pill
components.description: The only filled action. Hero, about, and the contact submit share it.
components.css: .ds-contact-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: #FFFFFF; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background: linear-gradient(123deg, #18011F 7%, #B600A8 37%, #7621B0 72%, #BE4C00 100%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: -3px; box-shadow: 0 4px 4px rgba(181, 1, 167, 0.25), inset 4px 4px 12px #7721b1; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-contact-pill:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-contact-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-contact-pill:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-contact-pill { padding: 14px 40px; font-size: 0.875rem; } } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-contact-pill { padding: 16px 48px; font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Ghost Pill
components.description: Every action that is not the contact pill: live project, code, all projects, CV, send another.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #D7E2EA; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #D7E2EA; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 14px 40px; font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: Transparent ice field on studio black. The label rises onto a black chip when the field is filled.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; color: rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.7); font-size: 1rem; transition: top 300ms, font-size 300ms, padding 300ms; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.625; color: #D7E2EA; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.35); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: transparent; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #D7E2EA; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.3); } .ds-field input:focus-visible + span, .ds-field input:not(:placeholder-shown) + span { top: -8px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #D7E2EA; background: #0C0C0C; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4); }

components.name: Poster Nav
components.description: Four uppercase ice links spread across the hero. Not fixed, and not rendered as a bar on the poster.
components.html: AboutServicesProjectsContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; } .ds-nav a { font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #D7E2EA; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 200ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-nav a { font-size: 1.125rem; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-nav a { font-size: 1.4rem; } }

components.css: .ds-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; color: #D7E2EA; background: #0C0C0C; border: 2px solid #D7E2EA; border-radius: 40px; font-family: Kanit, sans-serif; } .ds-stack-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; } .ds-stack-index { font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 140px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; } .ds-stack h3 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stack p { margin: 0; max-width: 42rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.8); } .ds-stack-ghost { align-self: flex-start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 32px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #D7E2EA; border: 2px solid #D7E2EA; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-stack-ghost:hover { background: rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.1); } .ds-stack-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-stack { padding: 24px; border-radius: 50px; } } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-stack { padding: 32px; border-radius: 60px; } }

narrative.overview:
The homepage is a poster on a dark studio floor. One black field, one white services sheet, steel display type, and a single magenta-to-ember action. Scale is dense at the headline and quiet in the paragraph. The name on the poster is Manuel Salvador; the work is full-stack product delivery.

The previous observatory is rejected: glass cards, sonar cyan, and a floating pill nav do not belong on this floor. Generic purple-on-black chrome is rejected too. Magenta lives inside one pill. It is a pinned accent, not a theme.
keyCharacteristics: Studio black field, ice ink, steel gradient display on that field
One white sheet with 40–60px top corners
One filled pill; every other action is a ghost stroke
Uppercase tracked labels, then quiet body copy
Kanit only, in the weights the site loads: 300, 400, 500, 700, and 900
Depth from an overlapping sheet and a sticky project stack, not glow

rules.name: The One Pill Rule
rules.body: Ember magenta, ember violet, and ember heat appear only inside the contact pill (including the sent-state disc that reuses that control). No other surface, rule, or heading takes this gradient. If a screen needs a second filled color, it does not get one.

rules.name: The Poster Then Quiet Rule
rules.body: Headlines are black weight, uppercase, and leading-none. Paragraphs do not inherit that size. On the white sheet, display type is solid studio black. The steel gradient is only for display type on the black field.

rules.name: The Steel On Black Rule
rules.body: Clip the gradient to the glyphs. Do not paint a flat white headline on the field, and do not run the steel gradient across the white sheet.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and on hover. Do not add a drop shadow, a glow, or a glass blur to a sheet, a card, or a field. Hover on a ghost pill is a 10% ice wash. Hover on the contact pill is opacity 0.85. Disabled pill opacity is 0.5.

rules.name: The Big Corner Rule
rules.body: A poster sheet or a stacked project card uses the 40 / 50 / 60px steps. Do not drop those surfaces back to an 8px or 12px radius. Pills stay fully round. The 16px radius is for fields and marquee tiles, not for the sheet.

dos: Do paint the field studio black (#0C0C0C) and set reading type in ice ink (#D7E2EA).
Do set poster display in Kanit 900, uppercase, leading-none, tracking -0.025em, and clip it to the steel gradient only on the black field.
Do keep a single filled action: the contact pill, white type on the ember gradient, fully round, with its own inset ring and shadow.
Do draw every other action as a ghost pill: 2px ice stroke, ice type, uppercase, tracking 0.1em.
Do round poster sheets and stack cards at 40px, 50px from 640px, and 60px from 768px.
Do place the original stills unframed on the field.
donts: Don't revive the observatory: glass cards, sonar cyan, glow shadows, or a floating pill nav.
Don't theme the page in purple. Magenta is a stop inside the one pill, not a surface color.
Don't set body copy in the display clamp, or introduce a second typeface. The face is Kanit.
Don't add hard offset shadows, eyebrows, or kickers. The floor is flat except for the contact pill’s own shadow.
Don't invent another name, 3D services, or prices. The poster is Manuel Salvador’s.
